text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest` because I don't have a shell here. I checked each fix by reading it against its test, so please run the suite to confirm it all passes.

- **`fees.py`:** the fee added the days to the daily rate instead of multiplying (`days_late * DAILY_FEE`).
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3, but the tests and the policy comment say 5.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned one event too many; it now returns the last `n`, or an empty list when `n <= 0`.
- **`factory.py`:** the sample data was missing the third book, `Emma`. I added it as Austen, 1815, 1 copy; the tests only check the title, so the other details are my choice.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`.
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist; it now imports it from `catalog.text`.

I didn't change any tests.
